name: mc_players
title: List online players
description:
Lists online players with position, facing and status, so builds can be placed relative to a player.

WHEN TO USE: whenever a request depends on where a player is or looks ("here", "in front of me", "at my feet", "this wall"); before a build that must not bury or trap a player; "who is online".
WHEN NOT TO USE: for terrain or blocks unrelated to a player (mc_survey, mc_inspect). Call once and reuse the coordinates.

PARAMETERS: optional lookRange 16-256 (default 16); optional name to report one player.

SIDE EFFECTS: read-only. `pos` is the block the feet occupy: "at my feet" means y-1 (building at pos fills the player's own cell); "in front of me" means `inFront`, one block toward `facing`. `exact` is the unrounded position, `eye` and `yaw`/`pitch` the exact look (F3 degrees: yaw 0 south, 90 west, 180 north, -90 east; pitch -90 up, 90 down) for mc_sightline or a first-person mc_render. `lookingAt` is the first block the player's sight hits within lookRange (position, state, face): "this" or "that wall" usually means that block. Also game mode, flying and health.

lookRange.description: How far lookingAt searches, in blocks. Default 16.

name.description: Report only this player (case-insensitive). Default: everyone online.
